title: Recommendation to Approve the Design and Installation of Wrought Iron Entrance
text:
[El Pueblo de Los Angeles Historical Monument (Olvera Street), 125 Paseo de la Plaza]
Recommendation to Approve the Design and Installation of Wrought Iron Entrance
  Security Gates at Olvera Street
summary: Approve design and installation of wrought iron entrance security gates at Olvera Street.

flag.reason: Permanent gates to close Olvera Street after hours.
